baseline: Your tests pass on the real helpers

variants.name: trim-only-left
variants.label: trim() removes the blanks at the start but not at the end
variants.hint: Put blanks on BOTH sides of the text.

variants.name: split-drops-empty-pieces
variants.label: split() drops empty pieces in the middle ("a,,b" gives only a and b)
variants.hint: The documentation says empty pieces are kept. Split a string that has two separators in a row.

variants.name: join-adds-a-trailing-separator
variants.label: join() puts the separator after the last piece too
variants.hint: Check the exact text that join() returns for a few pieces, and for one piece.

variants.name: parse-int-ignores-the-sign
variants.label: parse_int() drops the minus sign
variants.hint: Does parse_int work for negative numbers?

variants.name: trim-ignores-tabs-and-newlines
variants.label: trim() only removes spaces, not tabs or newlines
variants.hint: Blanks are space, tab, newline and carriage return.

variants.name: trim-keeps-a-blank-string
variants.label: trim() leaves a string of only blanks unchanged

variants.name: split-empty-string-gives-one-piece
variants.label: split("") returns one empty piece instead of none
variants.hint: How many pieces does the empty string have, according to the documentation?

variants.name: parse-int-accepts-trailing-text
variants.label: parse_int("12abc") returns 12 instead of rejecting the text
variants.hint: Try text that is not a number at all, text with a digit prefix, and the "-" alone.

variants.name: parse-int-wraps-around
variants.label: parse_int() accepts numbers that are too large for an int
variants.hint: The documentation promises std::out_of_range when the number does not fit. Test numbers just above the limit.
